metadata.description: Personal plugin marketplace for GitHub Copilot CLI — productivity skills for everyday development

plugins.name: p4-core
plugins.description: Essential productivity skills: intelligent model routing by task complexity and automatic Conventional Commits formatting

plugins.name: p4-coding
plugins.description: Coding standards and best practices: universal directives (SOLID, DRY, naming, error handling, security) with TypeScript and Python specific standards.

plugins.name: p4-plugin
plugins.description: Plugin lifecycle management: scaffold new plugins with all required files and registry entries in one step.

plugins.name: p4-buddy
plugins.description: <company>-specific skills: <hr-platform> mission report generator with full 145-entry competency catalog.

plugins.name: p4-agent
plugins.description: Agent definition auditor: validates markdown agent files for structural completeness, naming conventions, and cross-reference integrity.

plugins.name: p4-ccvv
plugins.description: AI-powered CV generation and management — multi-user profiles, job offer adaptation, and multi-format export.

plugins.name: p4-converter
plugins.description: Converts documents to Markdown (PDF, DOC, DOCX, PPT, PPTX) using a multi-step local tool pipeline with best-effort degradation.

plugins.name: p4-crawler
plugins.description: Web crawler and documentation extractor: crawls static sites (curl-only), filters by topic, downloads attachments, and generates structured Markdown output.
